name: Entropic Slam requires 60 Insanity to cast and still drains 40 (#10757)
contract: #10757 (confirmed defect, regression from merged #10485): Entropic Slam (804152) must stay uncastable below 60 Insanity, as on Ascension live (trainer tooltips 'Requires 60 Insanity', archived for every rank) and as Spell.dbc's CasterAuraSpell 680603 (the server DBC, the CoA client patch-T and Ascension live patch-T agree per #10485's own body) requires; it still drains 40 Insanity on a successful cast. Hammer of Twilight (805116) stays castable and spends 40 at 40 Insanity, unaffected by this fix.
